In 2009 Treasury Board approved a ~$309 million Transformation of Pay Administration path to replace aging systems with IBM PeopleSoft ( Phoenix ). Launch in 2016 produced mass pay errors. Auditor General reports document the failure of project management and oversight. Cost and backlog figures below cite AG and parliamentary materials — open the linked reports; secondary summaries are labeled.
Some secondary tallies use ~$9.3B (failures + replacement). Treat as estimate / composite until each component is opened in a primary.

Inference (labeled): Phoenix is the textbook case of political and schedule pressure overriding technical readiness — with costs and human harm documented by the AG, not by internet lore. Individual hardship stories below are illustrative; the liability chain is not asserted from this package alone.
